_meta.name: IntelliAudit Citation Rulebook v0.1
_meta.purpose: Rule-FIRST error injection. Each rule pre-specifies the violated standard so the citation ground truth is deterministic and independent of any LLM. The generator applies a rule's injection recipe to a concept-tagged clean statement and emits the rule's citation as ground truth.
_meta.citation_ground_truth_policy: asc_primary. The ASC code is the canonical citation label. dqc_rule is a SECONDARY machine-checkable label and every dqc_id below is marked verified=false until cross-checked against the official XBRL-US DQC ruleset (https://xbrl.us/data-rule/). Do NOT publish dqc ids as ground truth until verified.
_meta.scoring: Exact match on ASC code at three granularities: topic (606), subtopic (606-10), full (606-10-25-1). Report EM@topic / EM@subtopic / EM@full. This replaces AuditBench's fuzzy Top-K-over-vague-prose metric.

citation.rationale: Current assets are cash and other assets expected to be realized within one year / operating cycle; a current item placed under non-current assets misstates the current/non-current classification.

dqc_rule.note: 0015 is non-negative-values; classification may instead surface via calc-linkbase parenting. Verify.

rules.detection_predicate: row.concept is a *Current concept but row.section == NoncurrentAssets

citation.rationale: Classification of debt between current and non-current, including short-term obligations expected to be refinanced, is governed by ASC 470-10-45.

rules.detection_predicate: long-term debt concept under wrong current/non-current section

citation.rationale: An omitted line item is a completeness fault. No single ASC paragraph governs 'a line is missing' for an arbitrary concept; ASC 210-10-45-1 was a catch-all. Detection-only.

rules.note: Numerical errors are a DETECTION test, not a citation test. Flagged weak_citation. Do not over-weight these when scoring citation accuracy.

citation.rationale: A fabricated line is an existence/occurrence fault; no single ASC paragraph governs it. Detection-only.

dqc_rule.note: DQC_0004 Element Values Are Equal — canonical Assets == Liabilities+Equity check.

citation.rationale: Cash flow items must be classified as operating, investing, or financing per ASC 230-10-45; e.g., capex is investing, dividends paid are financing.

rules.detection_predicate: cash-flow concept under a section inconsistent with its ASC 230 classification

injection.narrative: prematurely recognized revenue for goods/services not yet transferred

citation.rationale: Revenue is recognized when control of goods/services transfers to the customer (performance obligation satisfied). Premature recognition violates ASC 606-10-25.

rules.detection_predicate: revenue overstated relative to satisfied performance obligations in transactions
rules.requires: income statement seed + transaction narratives encoding obligation timing

citation.rationale: Lessee lease classification (finance vs operating) follows the ASC 842-10-25-2 criteria; presenting an operating lease as a finance lease (or vice versa) misstates both the right-of-use asset and the lease liability.

rules.detection_predicate: lease asset/liability labelled finance while its paired item remains operating

injection.narrative: inventory carried above net realizable value; required write-down omitted

citation.rationale: Inventory is measured at the lower of cost and net realizable value; omitting a required NRV write-down overstates inventory (ASC 330-10-35).

rules.detection_predicate: inventory carrying value > NRV given in facts

citation.rationale: A negative balance on a non-negative element is a data-quality fault (DQC), not an ASC paragraph. Detection-only.
citation.audit_note: v0.1 asserted ASC 210-10-45-1; removed after external audit (did not govern the fault).

dqc_rule.note: DQC_0015 Negative Values — the canonical machine check for this class.

injection.narrative: goodwill carried above its implied fair value; required impairment not recognised

citation.rationale: Goodwill is not amortised but tested for impairment; carrying goodwill above its implied fair value without recognising the loss violates ASC 350-20-35.

rules.detection_predicate: goodwill inconsistent with the enclosing subtotal / prior-period balance

injection.narrative: available-for-sale securities not carried at fair value

citation.rationale: Available-for-sale debt securities are measured at fair value at each reporting date; carrying them at another amount violates ASC 320-10-35.

rules.detection_predicate: AFS/marketable securities balance inconsistent with its subtotal
